# NWalign standalone program test cases (USalign-beta branch)
# run_test.py appends "-outdir ." to every case, so generated files stay in the
# case working directory and are collected as comparison artifacts.
# Format: <name> <working_dir> <arguments...>
# <working_dir> is relative to the data/ directory
#
# Covers: all four -glocal modes (0 global, 1 glocal-query, 2 glocal-both,
# 3 local Smith-Waterman), FASTA input via -infmt1/-infmt2 4, and a real protein
# pair. NWalign writes only to stdout, so no generated artifacts are compared.

nwalign_basic    nwalign ../help/model.pdb ../help/native.pdb
nwalign_glocal1  nwalign ../help/model.pdb ../help/native.pdb -glocal 1
nwalign_glocal2  nwalign ../help/model.pdb ../help/native.pdb -glocal 2
nwalign_glocal3  nwalign ../help/model.pdb ../help/native.pdb -glocal 3
nwalign_fasta    nwalign seq1.fasta seq3.fasta -infmt1 4 -infmt2 4 -glocal 3
nwalign_real     nwalign ../101m.pdb ../1mba.pdb
